entities.name: Helicobacter pylori infection
observations: The 2024 ACG guideline addresses who to test and recommends active infection testing in appropriate candidates; guideline citation PMID:39626064.

entities.name: Test adult household contacts
observations: The 2024 ACG guideline includes adult household members of people with H. pylori infection among groups for whom testing is recommended; use a nonserologic test for active infection.

entities.name: Active H. pylori testing
observations: Stool antigen and urea breath testing detect active H. pylori infection; antibody serology cannot reliably distinguish current from past infection.
